title: UAP incidents routinely in counter-WMD intelligence stream

tellings.quote: These were incidents that were reported um in our intelligence stream very often.

plain: Reports of UAP, the government's term for unidentified anomalous phenomena or UFOs, turned up often in the Pentagon intelligence flow meant to track threats from weapons of mass destruction, according to a former Pentagon official named Matthew Brown. Brown tells Michels he saw this himself around 2018: "These were incidents that were reported in our intelligence stream very often." If so, UFO incidents were a routine part of serious security reporting rather than a rare oddity.
